review.notes: Full review of a revision of a roadmap on main. All 95 labels of the README on main are kept with their subjects; every restated item was recomputed and compared with the signature of the Tau Ceti declaration on its In Tau Ceti line (about 150 opened at the pin; all 211 dotted names resolve). Sample: all fourteen milestones and the owned-elsewhere list; 14 source locators read in the four readable manifest sources, one wrong (the locator of D.16 is Theorem 2 (2) of Yu-Wang-Samworth, not Theorem 1: small correction). Suggested.lean elaborates with five sorry warnings only; no binder lost; one-tactic probe leaves all five open; none is at the pins. Automatic checks all passed; dependency check 0 problems; nothing outside the folder. Previous review's four small corrections are repaired or answered; its format note (missing reference entries) is not. Not readable: Davis-Kahan 1970, Rosenblum 1956, Davis 1963, Bhatia-Davis-McIntosh 1983, Bhatia's book. For the humans: Kitware copyright header, B.12 narrowed to complex scalars, unread principal source.
